$comment: axRange pipeline harness config (tracked, shared). Permission allowlist lets background workers run reads/tests/preflight unattended; deploy/destroy/build/commit/push/manual-qm stay gated (the check-back points); inbound git sync is denied per the Git Policy. Hooks wire the lessons store + doc-drift enforcement. Doc-counter drift is HARD-BLOCKED only at `git commit` (PreToolUse commit-guard) — where docs must match source; the Stop hook is a non-looping ADVISORY nudge (backs off on stop_hook_active) so transient drift during a multi-stage pipeline never wedges the turn. Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). Hook commands are cwd-independent (LES-067 fix): each anchors `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)` and invokes `$R/scripts/hooks.py` (+ `$R/.venv/bin/python`) by absolute path, so a subagent whose cwd != repo root no longer gets silent Edit/Write failures; `git rev-parse` falls back to `.` outside a worktree.

hooks.command: sh -c 'R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .); PY=$([ -x "$R/.venv/bin/python" ] && echo "$R/.venv/bin/python" || echo python3); exec $PY "$R/scripts/hooks.py" read-guard'
